Description.SourceString:
Garou druids borrow from nature when crafting staves or weaving robes. In Ghornfell, they took antlers from deer, and leather from their hunted prey. In the Umbral Sands they were forced to adopt a… sparklier approach.

Kaira, druid of the Softfoot tribe, was one of the first of the Moon Garou to hunt through the sands in search of materials they could use to craft robes of their own. They expected magnificent beasts with scales and horns the likes of which they had never seen. They found the kalphites instead.

Their first interaction did not go well.
